WITH RECURSIVE page_tree AS (

        p.page_id,
        p.name,
        p.path,
        p.path AS full_path,
        1 AS level

        SELECT 1 FROM page_hierarchy ph WHERE ph.child_page_id = p.page_id
    )
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        p.page_id,
        p.name,
        p.path,
        CONCAT(pt.full_path, ' > ', p.path) AS full_path,
        pt.level + 1 AS level
    FROM pages p

    INNER JOIN page_tree pt ON ph.parent_page_id = pt.page_id
),

        c.category_name,
        c.parent_category_id,
        cp.full_path || ' > ' || c.category_name
    FROM categories c

    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
),

        SUM(total_revenues) OVER (ORDER BY product_id) AS cumulative_revenues
    FROM product_sales
)

WITH portfolio_calculations AS (
    SELECT 
        up.user_id,
        up.ticker,
        up.number_of_shares,
        up.purchase_price,
        sd.close_price AS current_price,
        (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) AS initial_value,
        (up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price) AS current_value,
        (up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price - up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) AS gain,
        CASE 
            WHEN up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price > 0 
            THEN (up.number_of_shares * sd.close_price - up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) / (up.number_of_shares * up.purchase_price) 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS portfolio_return
    FROM user_portfolios up
    JOIN stock_data sd ON up.ticker = sd.ticker
    WHERE up.is_active = true
        AND sd.date = (SELECT MAX(date) FROM stock_data)
),
market_calculations AS (
    SELECT 
        md.market_index,
        md.market_value,
        LAG(md.market_value) OVER (ORDER BY md.date) AS previous_market_value,
        CASE 
            WHEN LAG(md.market_value) OVER (ORDER BY md.date) > 0 
            THEN (md.market_value - LAG(md.market_value) OVER (ORDER BY md.date)) / LAG(md.market_value) OVER (ORDER BY md.date) 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS market_return
    FROM market_data md
    WHERE md.date IN (
        SELECT MAX(date) FROM market_data
        UNION
        SELECT MAX(date) - INTERVAL '1 day' FROM market_data
    )
),
user_aggregates AS (
    SELECT 
        pc.user_id,
        SUM(pc.current_value) AS total_current_value,
        SUM(pc.initial_value) AS total_initial_value,
        SUM(pc.gain) AS total_gain,
        SUM(pc.gain) AS total_net_gain,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(pc.initial_value) > 0 
            THEN SUM(pc.gain) / SUM(pc.initial_value) 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS total_return,
        AVG(pc.portfolio_return) AS average_portfolio_return
    FROM portfolio_calculations pc
    GROUP BY pc.user_id
)

        al.video_id,
        COUNT(*) AS total_accesses
    FROM access_logs al
    GROUP BY al.video_id
    ORDER BY total_accesses DESC
    LIMIT 3
),
top_users_per_video AS (
    SELECT 
        vac.video_id,
        al.user_id,
        COUNT(*) AS user_access_count,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY vac.video_id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS user_rank
    FROM video_access_counts vac
    JOIN access_logs al ON vac.video_id = al.video_id
    GROUP BY vac.video_id, al.user_id
),
video_annotations AS (
    SELECT 
        v.video_id,
        STRING_AGG(fa.annotation, ', ') AS annotations
    FROM videos v
    LEFT JOIN frames f ON v.video_id = f.video_id
    LEFT JOIN frame_annotations fa ON f.frame_id = fa.frame_id
    GROUP BY v.video_id
)
SELECT 
    v.video_name,
    u.user_name,
    tupv.user_access_count,
    va.annotations
FROM top_users_per_video tupv
JOIN videos v ON tupv.video_id = v.video_id
JOIN users u ON tupv.user_id = u.user_id
LEFT JOIN video_annotations va ON tupv.video_id = va.video_id
WHERE tupv.user_rank = 1
ORDER BY v.video_name;

    SELECT 
        vr.legislation_id,
        vr.legislation_name,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) AS yes_votes,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'No' THEN 1 END) AS no_votes,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'Not Voting' THEN 1 END) AS not_voting_votes,
        ABS(COUNT(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'Yes' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN vr.vote = 'No' THEN 1 END)) AS vote_difference
    FROM voting_records vr
    WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM vr.vote_date) = 2022
    GROUP BY vr.legislation_id, vr.legislation_name
),
finance_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        cf.legislation_id,
        AVG(cf.amount_supported) AS avg_support,
        AVG(cf.amount_opposed) AS avg_opposition
    FROM campaign_financing cf

    GROUP BY cf.legislation_id
)

    vc.vote_difference,
    fa.avg_support,
    fa.avg_opposition
FROM vote_counts vc
JOIN finance_avg fa ON vc.legislation_id = fa.legislation_id
ORDER BY vc.vote_difference DESC
